page.overview:
Who is Ugo Firenze?

Ugo Firenze was the assistant manager of The Salusan Bull.

Ugo Firenze grew up in a vineyard and fought for House Atreides in offworld wars such as the Liberation of Ix (in which his brother Enzo was killed), the raid on Giedi Prime and the Arrakis campaign. He later travelled to Arrakis alongside his Duke Leto Atreides and became the assistant manager of The Salusan Bull.

Firenze was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. He outlined his military history and his duties such as handling security operations and performing as the wine steward.
